headline: Healthy volume-led growth; RM inflation and Reynolds’ integration weigh on profitability

highlights: We note: (1) More than 80% of growth was volume-led, reflecting healthy underlying demand and the company's continued focus on market share gains.
(2) However, margins were impacted due to elevated RM costs and incremental employee expenses and under-absorption of fixed overheads, following the integration of the Reynolds.
(3) Raw material inflation remained elevated at ~15%, while management continued to follow a calibrated pricing approach to protect volumes.
(6) Management has retained its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 18–20%, while its targeted EBITDA margin range remains at 16–17%.
valuation: (6) Management has retained its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 18–20%, while its targeted EBITDA margin range remains at 16–17%.
Maintain BUY with a DCF-based revised TP of INR 2,200 (earlier INR 2,600; implied P/E of 41x FY28E EPS).
The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
watch: However, persistent input cost inflation and near-term margin pressure remain key monitorable.
